problem: Lena caught 4 fish at the lake and her uncle Bruno caught 8. They dropped every fish into one cooler to carry home. How many fish ended up in the cooler?
How many shells are in the jar now? On the beach Kofi picked up 4 shells, his sister Mira picked up 8, and they poured all of them into one glass jar.
A delivery robot rolled along the hospital hallways for 3 hours, covering 4 kilometres every hour. What distance did the robot cover?
follow_up_questions: On the way back to its charger it slows down to 2 kilometres per hour. How many hours does it take to get back?
Counting both directions, how many hours was the robot rolling?

problem: How many kilometres did Grandpa Tomas cycle along the canal path? He pedalled at a steady 4 kilometres an hour and kept going for 3 hours.
follow_up_questions: Riding home against the wind, he can only do 2 kilometres in an hour. How long is the ride home, in hours?
What is the total time he spent cycling, out and back?

problem: Hana started the day with 90 dollars in her piggy bank. After she bought a new skateboard, only 26 dollars remained. How much did the skateboard cost?
follow_up_questions: Her aunt then gives her 15 dollars. How much money does Hana have now?
A helmet costs 50 dollars. How much more money does Hana need for the helmet?

problem: By noon, only 26 tomatoes were left in the market stall's basket, though it held 90 when the market opened. What number of tomatoes had been sold?
follow_up_questions: The farmer carries 15 more tomatoes over from the truck and tips them into the basket. How many are in the basket now?
The basket is full when it holds 50 tomatoes. How many more are needed to fill it?

problem: Before the town festival, a baker plans to bake 6 cakes each day for 5 days. How many cakes will she bake?
follow_up_questions: The festival needs 48 cakes. How many more cakes still have to be baked?
Baking 6 cakes a day, how many extra days will she need?
Altogether, how many days will the baker have spent baking?

problem: For 5 days in a row, the school librarian shelves 6 boxes of new books every day. What is the total number of boxes she shelves?
follow_up_questions: There are 48 boxes to put away in all. How many boxes are still waiting?
At 6 boxes a day, how many more days of shelving are left?
Once every box is on the shelves, how many days will the librarian have worked?

problem: A sailboat crossed the bay to the island, a trip of 24 kilometres, moving at 8 kilometres an hour. How many hours did the crossing take?
follow_up_questions: Coming back, the wind dies down and the trip takes 1 hour more. How long is the trip back?

problem: How long does it take the horse cart to reach the market? The market is 24 miles from the farm, and the cart travels 8 miles each hour.
follow_up_questions: On the return the horse is tired, so the trip lasts 1 hour longer. How many hours does the return take?

problem: The school library keeps 35 comic books on the front shelf and 28 in the back room. What is the total number of comic books?
follow_up_questions: The librarian stacks them in piles of 7. How many piles are there?
At the book sale each pile sells for 8 dollars. How much money is raised if every pile sells?
The library spends 25 dollars of it on new bookmarks. How much money is left?

problem: How many marbles does Diego own? He keeps 35 in a biscuit tin and 28 in his sock drawer.
follow_up_questions: He sorts them into little bags of 7. How many bags does he fill?
Selling each bag at the yard sale for 8 dollars, how much money does he make?
Diego then spends 25 dollars on a kite. How much of his money is left?

problem: Priya had 6 trophies on her bookcase. At the chess tournament she won 3 more and also collected 7 autographs. How many trophies does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She lends 2 trophies to the school display. How many does she keep at home?
At the next tournament she wins 5 more. How many trophies does she have now?

problem: How many badges are on Leo's scout sash after camp? Before camp he had 6. During the week he earned 3 new badges and ate 7 pancakes at one breakfast.
follow_up_questions: He gives 2 badges to his cousin. How many are left on his sash?
Then he earns 5 more at the spring meeting. How many badges does Leo have now?

problem: After the quiz show host gave Amara's team 8 extra points, their total became 95. How many points did the team have before the extra points?
follow_up_questions: A trophy goes to the first team to reach 99 points. How many more points does Amara's team need?

problem: The pantry shelf now holds 95 jars of jam, because Grandma just added 8 jars she made today. What was the number of jars on the shelf before she added hers?
follow_up_questions: The shelf can fit 99 jars. How many more jars can go on it?

problem: A beekeeper had 8 jars of honey on her table. Then her neighbour brought over 96 more jars. How many jars of honey does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She packs the jars into boxes of 8. How many boxes does she fill?
Each box sells for 5 dollars. How much money do the boxes bring in?

problem: What is the number of seed packets the garden club has now? It owned 8 packets, and a shop gave it a gift of 96 more.
follow_up_questions: Members put the packets into envelopes, 8 to an envelope. How many envelopes get filled?
The club charges 5 dollars per envelope at the plant sale. What do all the envelopes earn?

problem: A bus driver picked up 9 passengers on the first trip and 7 on the second. The bus radio played old songs all day. How many passengers rode the bus on those two trips?
How many letters did Chen write this weekend? He wrote 9 on Saturday and 7 on Sunday. His cat kept sitting on the paper.
Each finished puzzle book earns 25 points in the reading club. Aisha finished 3 puzzle books this month. How many points did she earn?
follow_up_questions: She trades 60 points for a bookmark set. How many points does Aisha have left?
Later she finishes 2 more puzzle books. How many points does she have now?

problem: Find how many coins Tariq has in his racing game. Every race he wins pays 25 coins, and he has just won 3 races in a row.
follow_up_questions: He spends 60 coins on new tyres for his car. How many coins remain?
After that he wins 2 more races. What is his coin total now?

problem: Kemal picked 12 apples in the orchard. His sister Dina picked 5 more apples than he did. How many apples did Dina pick?
follow_up_questions: How many apples did the brother and sister pick altogether?

problem: How many paper cranes has Haruto folded? His friend Maya folded 12 cranes, and Haruto managed 5 more than Maya.
follow_up_questions: Together, how many cranes have the two friends folded?

problem: Pip the class hamster had 7 wooden chew sticks. For his birthday the children brought him 6 more. How many chew sticks does Pip have now?
follow_up_questions: By Friday he has gnawed through 4 of them. How many sticks are still whole?
The teacher splits the whole sticks equally among 3 boxes. How many sticks go in each box?
She puts 2 new sticks in every box. How many sticks are in the boxes altogether?

problem: What is the number of board games in the toy library now? It had 7 on its shelf before a family donated 6 more.
follow_up_questions: Sadly, 4 games turn out to be missing pieces and are thrown out. How many complete games are left?
These are shared out evenly into 3 lending bags. How many games are in each bag?
If every bag gets 2 more games, how many games are in all the bags together?

problem: Grandma baked 18 cookies and divided them equally among her 3 grandchildren. How many cookies did each grandchild get?
follow_up_questions: One napkin can wrap 2 cookies. How many napkins does each grandchild need?
How many napkins do all the grandchildren need together?

problem: How many crayons will each table get? Ms. Ortiz has 18 crayons to hand out, the same number to each of the 3 art tables.
follow_up_questions: A small cup holds 2 crayons. How many cups does each table need?
Counting every table, how many cups are needed?

problem: A river ferry carries visitors to a castle 28 kilometres upstream. It moves at 7 kilometres an hour. Seagulls follow the boat the whole way. How many hours does the trip take?
How many hours will the bike race last for a rider who keeps a speed of 7 miles an hour? The course is 28 miles long. Crowds cheer along the road.

A sock drawer holds 9 blue socks, 5 grey socks and 3 white socks, all mixed up. In the dark, Tomasz wants to be certain he has at least one sock of every colour. How many socks must he take out to be sure?
What is the smallest number of marbles Ayo must draw from a closed box to be sure of getting at least one of each colour? Inside are 3 yellow, 5 purple and 9 orange marbles, and he cannot look.
A farm delivered 7 dozen eggs to the school kitchen. How many eggs is that?
follow_up_questions: The cook uses 6 eggs for each tray of muffins. How many trays can she make?
Each class gets 2 trays. How many classes get muffins?
Every class also gets 3 jugs of milk. How many jugs of milk are needed?

problem: How many pencils came in the delivery? The office supply shop sent 7 dozen pencils to the art school.
follow_up_questions: The teacher puts 6 pencils in each pencil case. How many cases are filled?
Every table shares 2 cases. How many tables get pencils?
Each table also gets 3 erasers. How many erasers does the teacher need?

problem: Four friends at the beach each collect 9 shells to decorate their sandcastle. What is the total number of shells they collect?
follow_up_questions: To finish the castle they need 50 shells. How many more shells must they find?

problem: How many laps did the relay team run at practice, if each of its 4 runners ran 9 laps of the track?
follow_up_questions: The coach wanted 50 laps in total. How many more laps were needed?

problem: Mia has 72 holiday photos to put in an album. Each page holds 8 photos. How many pages will her photos fill?
How many cartons will the juice factory need? Today 72 bottles came off the line, and every carton takes 8.
Rohan had 52 reward stars on the class chart and 17 stickers in his book. He spent 24 stars on extra computer time. How many stars does he have left?
follow_up_questions: A trip to the class treasure chest costs 40 stars. How many more stars does Rohan need?
He earns 3 stars for every spelling test. How many tests must he take to get enough?

problem: How many stamps does Ines have left for her collection? She started with 52 stamps and 17 postcards, then gave 24 stamps to a pen pal.
follow_up_questions: Her album needs 40 stamps to fill a page. How many more stamps does Ines need?
Her uncle sends her 3 stamps in every letter. How many letters must arrive to get them?

problem: A bakery sold 63 loaves of rye bread last week, the same number each day. How many loaves did it sell per day?
follow_up_questions: Each loaf was topped with 2 handfuls of seeds. How many handfuls were used each day?

problem: Over one week, Kenji read 63 pages of his adventure book, reading the same amount every day. What was his daily number of pages?
follow_up_questions: Each page took him 2 minutes. How many minutes did he read each day?

problem: A cafe made 12 sandwiches and 5 salads for a picnic. By noon, 8 of the sandwiches had been eaten. How many sandwiches were left?
How many cupcakes are still on the tray? The party table had 12 cupcakes and 5 jellies, and the children gobbled up 8 cupcakes before the games began.
In the spelling bee, Class A spelled 43 words right and Class B spelled 27. By how many words is Class A ahead?
follow_up_questions: Class B gets 20 more words right in the final round. Now how many words ahead is Class B?

problem: How far ahead were the Tigers when the basketball game paused? They had 43 points, and the Sharks had 27.
follow_up_questions: If the Sharks then score 20 more points while the Tigers score nothing, by how many points do the Sharks lead?

problem: The school fair took 88 paper cups from the storeroom, and just 7 cups were left on the shelf. The storeroom smelled of dust. How many cups were on the shelf before the fair?
follow_up_questions: The caretaker buys enough cups to have 50 on the shelf. How many cups does he buy?

problem: How many nails were in the box at the start? A carpenter used 88 nails to build a fence, leaving only 7 in the box. Birds sang on the fence posts while he worked.
follow_up_questions: He wants 50 nails in the box for the next job. How many nails should he buy?

problem: The town theatre has twelve rows of seats, with fourteen seats in each row. How many seats are in the theatre?
follow_up_questions: For the weekend show, 2 tickets are printed for each seat, one for each night. How many tickets are printed?

problem: Find the number of tiles on the bathroom wall. The tiler laid 12 rows, putting 14 tiles in each.
follow_up_questions: Each tile needs 2 dabs of glue. How many dabs of glue did the tiler use?

problem: There were some books in the classroom reading corner. Mr. Lindqvist brought in 7 from home, and now the corner has 23. How many books were there before?
follow_up_questions: The corner should hold 35 books. How many more books are needed?
Three parents agree to bring in those books, each bringing the same number. How many books does each parent bring?

problem: How many beads were on Zara's string before she threaded on 7 more? Now there are 23 beads on it.
follow_up_questions: Her necklace needs 35 beads. How many more beads must go on?
Zara and two friends share the threading equally. How many beads does each of the three thread?

problem: Three friends picked strawberries at a farm. Lucia picked 14, Omar picked 9 and Yara picked 16. How many strawberries did they pick altogether?
follow_up_questions: They put 3 strawberries on each cake. How many cakes can they decorate?
They sell each cake for 4 dollars. How much money do they make?

problem: What is the total number of leaves collected for the art project? The red group brought 14 leaves, the blue group 9, and the green group 16.
follow_up_questions: Each leaf picture uses 3 leaves. How many pictures can the class make?
At the school fair every picture is sold for 4 dollars. How much money will that raise?

problem: A pet shop had 9 puppies in the front pen. By lunchtime, two had gone home with new families. How many puppies are still in the pen?
How many kites are left hanging in the toy shop? There were 9, and a customer just bought 2.
A summer camp runs for 2 weeks, with 6 campfire nights each week. How many campfire nights are there in all?
follow_up_questions: At each campfire night the campers sing 3 songs. How many songs are sung altogether?

problem: Find the total number of puppet shows this season. The library puts on six shows each month, and the puppet season lasts 2 months.
follow_up_questions: The librarian hands out 3 stickers after every show. How many stickers does she need?

problem: Kiri planted 9 tulips and 4 bushes in one flower bed. Her brother planted 7 tulips in another bed. How many tulips are in the two beds?
follow_up_questions: Each tulip bulb cost 3 dollars. How much did the tulip bulbs cost?

problem: How many crayons do the two boxes hold? Juan's box has 9 crayons and 4 markers, and Siti's box has 7 crayons.
follow_up_questions: Each crayon costs 3 cents. What do all the crayons cost?

problem: A rowing team rowed 12 kilometres across the lake in 3 hours, at a steady pace. How many kilometres did they row each hour?
follow_up_questions: The way back is only 8 kilometres. At the same speed, how many hours will it take?
They stop for 1 hour to have a picnic on the way back. How long does the return trip take in all?
How many hours did the team spend going across the lake and back?

problem: Find how many kilometres a donkey walked each hour. It carried bags 12 kilometres up the mountain path in 3 hours, never changing speed.
follow_up_questions: The path back down to the village is 8 kilometres. How many hours will the donkey take at the same speed?
It rests for 1 hour at a well on the way down. How long is the trip down altogether?
Counting the trip up and the trip down, how many hours did the donkey travel?

problem: Three friends at the zoo each need a 9-dollar ticket, and Lina pays for everyone. How much does Lina pay?
follow_up_questions: She hands over a 50-dollar note. How much change does she receive?
Her two friends each pay her back 9 dollars. How much did the tickets end up costing Lina herself?

problem: How much does Mr. Osei spend at the bookshop if he buys 3 notebooks that cost 9 dollars each?
follow_up_questions: He pays with a 50-dollar bill. What change does he get?
Two of the notebooks are for his neighbours, who each give him 9 dollars. How much did Mr. Osei spend himself in the end?

problem: A pumpkin at the farm show weighed 46 kilograms, and a watermelon weighed 31 kilograms. Flags flapped over the show tent. How much heavier was the pumpkin than the watermelon?
How much longer is the green rope than the blue one? The green rope is 46 metres long and the blue rope is 31 metres. The gym smelled of fresh paint.
Ella's jigsaw puzzle has 64 pieces. Her cousin's puzzle has 14 fewer pieces. How many pieces does her cousin's puzzle have?
follow_up_questions: How many pieces are there in both puzzles?
They pour all the pieces into 2 bags with the same number in each. How many pieces go in each bag?

problem: How many beads are on the shorter necklace? The long necklace Nadia made has 64 beads, and her short one has 14 fewer.
follow_up_questions: What is the total number of beads on the two necklaces?
She had bought all those beads in 2 equal packets. How many beads were in each packet?

problem: Ana has 8 five-dollar notes saved for the school book fair. How much money does she have?
follow_up_questions: She spends 12 dollars on a poster. How much is left?
Then she buys 4 bookmarks at 3 dollars each. How much money is left now?
She keeps half of what is left for next year's fair. How much does she keep?

problem: How much money does Grandpa Jun give his grandson if he hands him 8 bills, each worth 5 dollars?
follow_up_questions: The boy pays 12 dollars for a toy train. How much money remains?
Next he buys 4 juice boxes at 3 dollars each. How much does he have now?
He puts half of the remaining money in his piggy bank. How much goes in?

problem: There are 45 apples on the orchard's old tree. Birds have pecked 19 of them. How many apples have not been pecked?
follow_up_questions: The farmer splits the good apples evenly into 2 baskets. How many go in each basket?

problem: How many library books have no torn pages? The librarian counted 45 books in the children's corner and found torn pages in 19 of them.
follow_up_questions: The good books are shared equally between 2 classrooms. How many does each classroom get?

problem: A pet shelter had 18 bags of dog food in the storeroom. A pet shop donated 35 more bags, and then a vet brought 27. How many bags are in the storeroom now?
follow_up_questions: Each foster family takes 4 bags. How many families can get food?
On the first day, 9 families collect their bags. How many bags remain after that?
The following day 6 more families come. How many bags are left?

problem: How many tins of paint does the art club have now? It had 18 tins, a hardware store gave it 35, and parents later added 27.
follow_up_questions: Every mural team gets 4 tins. How many teams can get paint?
In the first week 9 teams pick up their tins. How many tins are still on the shelf?
In the second week 6 more teams collect theirs. How many tins remain?

problem: Leila had 9 shells in her bucket from the morning walk. In the afternoon she found fifteen more. How many shells does she have now?
How many stamps are in Kwesi's passport now? It held 9 stamps from earlier trips, and this summer added 15 more.
Marta brought 48 old books to the library sale, and her friend Jonas brought 14. Marta had sold 35 of hers when the sale closed. How many of Marta's books are still unsold?
follow_up_questions: Each book sells for 2 dollars. How much money will Marta get for the rest?

problem: How many of Tahu's 48 seedlings still need planting? His sister Hine has 14 seedlings of her own, and Tahu has already put 35 of his in the ground.
follow_up_questions: Each seedling needs 2 cups of water. How many cups will Tahu's remaining seedlings need?

problem: The craft box held 65 beads. When Lucas tipped it over, 4 beads rolled under the sofa and were lost. How many beads are still in the box?
follow_up_questions: Lucas uses 5 beads on each of 9 bracelets. How many beads are left in the box?

problem: How many pencils are in the classroom pot after the windy day? There were 65, but 4 blew out of the open window.
follow_up_questions: The teacher hands 5 pencils to each of 9 tables. How many pencils remain in the pot?

problem: Every morning, Grandma Rosa walks 6 kilometres around the park at 3 kilometres an hour. How long does her walk take?
follow_up_questions: She walks 5 mornings a week. How many hours is that in total?

problem: How many hours does the ferry ride take? The ferry travels 6 miles across the bay and moves at only 3 miles an hour.
follow_up_questions: It makes this crossing 5 times a day. How many hours does it spend crossing each day?

problem: Sofia baked 14 muffins on Saturday and 29 on Sunday for the bake sale. How many muffins did she bake over the weekend?
follow_up_questions: Each muffin used 2 spoonfuls of sugar. How many spoonfuls did she use?

problem: How many emails did the club leader send in two weeks? In the first week she sent 14, and in the second week 29.
follow_up_questions: Each email took her 2 minutes to write. How many minutes did she spend writing them?

problem: A toy factory built 15 bicycles and 12 cars. Every bicycle has 2 wheels and every car has 4. How many wheels did the factory need?
follow_up_questions: The factory had 95 wheels at the start of the day. How many wheels are left?

problem: How many roof nails did the craft club use? It built 15 small birdhouses, using 2 nails on each roof, and 12 large ones, using 4 nails on each.
follow_up_questions: The nail tin held 95 nails at the start. How many nails remain in the tin?

problem: Some crackers were in the snack tin. Malik ate 9 of them and 6 were left. The tin had a picture of a lighthouse on the lid. How many crackers were in the tin at the start?
follow_up_questions: His mum adds 10 more crackers to the tin. How many crackers are in it now?

problem: How many stickers did Zoe have before she decorated her notebook? She stuck 9 onto the cover and has 6 left over. Her notebook is bright purple.
follow_up_questions: Her friend gives her 10 more stickers. How many does Zoe have now?

problem: A school library got 36 new books on Monday and 28 on Tuesday. When the librarian checked them, 15 had torn covers and were sent back. How many good new books does the library keep?
follow_up_questions: The good books are shared equally among 7 classrooms. How many books does each classroom get?
Each classroom already had 3 new books from last month. How many new books does each classroom have now?

problem: Work out how many eggs at the farm stand are still fit to sell. The hens laid 36 eggs on Monday and 28 on Tuesday, but 15 of them cracked.
follow_up_questions: The good eggs are packed equally into 7 boxes. How many eggs go in each box?
The farmer adds 3 duck eggs to every box. How many eggs are in each box now?

problem: On the playground there are 8 benches, and 5 children sit on each bench. How many children are sitting on the benches?
follow_up_questions: Then all the children from 3 benches go inside. How many children are still on the benches?

problem: How many candles are on the dinner tables? The restaurant has 8 tables with 5 candles on each.
follow_up_questions: A waiter takes away every candle from 3 tables. How many candles are left on the tables?

problem: The school choir stands in 3 rows on the stage. For the concert the music teacher printed 6 stacks of song sheets, with 10 sheets in each stack. How many song sheets did she print?
How many crayons came in Kim's order? She ordered 6 packs of crayons with 10 crayons in each pack, plus 3 sketchbooks.
Ravi's small bucket holds 8 cups of sand. His big bucket holds 6 times as many cups. How many cups of sand does the big bucket hold?
follow_up_questions: How many more cups does the big bucket hold than the small one?
If Ravi fills the big bucket 2 times, how many cups of sand is that?

problem: How many passengers can the big ferry carry, if it holds 6 times as many as the little water taxi, which carries 8?
follow_up_questions: What is the difference between the number of passengers the two boats carry?
The big ferry makes 2 full trips. How many passengers does it carry in all?

problem: In the spelling game, Nia spelled 7 words correctly. Her friend Ben spelled twice as many correctly. How many words did Ben spell correctly?
How many laps did Marco swim? His sister swam 7 laps of the pool, and Marco swam twice as many.
A classroom has 41 crayons and 26 rulers. The principal brings in 12 more crayons. How many crayons are in the classroom now?
follow_up_questions: Eight crayons are broken and thrown out. How many crayons are left?
The teacher puts them equally into 5 cups. How many crayons go in each cup?

problem: How many toy cars does the playroom have after a neighbour gives 12 more? Before the gift it had 41 toy cars and 26 dolls.
follow_up_questions: 8 of the cars have broken wheels and are thrown away. How many cars are left?
The cars are lined up equally on 5 shelves. How many cars sit on each shelf?

problem: A toy shop had 6 teddy bears on display. A delivery truck brought 75 more. How many teddy bears does the shop have now?
follow_up_questions: Each shelf fits 9 bears. How many shelves are needed?
A shelf costs 8 dollars. How much will the shelves cost?
The shop owner has 90 dollars. How much will she have left after buying the shelves?

problem: How many fish are in the aquarium's big tank now? It had 6 fish before the keeper released 75 young ones into it.
follow_up_questions: The keeper moves them into smaller tanks of 9 fish each. How many small tanks are filled?
Every small tank uses 8 scoops of gravel. How many scoops are needed in all?
There are 90 scoops of gravel in the shed. How many scoops are left once the tanks are done?

problem: Kofi baked 32 muffins and 18 cookies for the class party. His friend baked 27 muffins. How many muffins do the two boys have together?
follow_up_questions: The class eats 40 muffins at the party. How many muffins are left?

problem: How many apples will reach the cider press? Hamid's orchard gave 32 apples and 18 pears, Ruth's tree gave 27 apples, and they bring every apple to the press.
follow_up_questions: The press uses 40 apples for the first batch. How many apples are still waiting?

problem: The ice cream van sold 58 cones on Saturday but only 24 on the rainy Sunday. How many more cones were sold on Saturday than on Sunday?
follow_up_questions: How many cones were sold over the two days?
The driver had hoped to sell 90 cones. How many cones short of that was he?

problem: By how many did book loans drop from March to April? The town library lent 58 books in March and 24 in April.
follow_up_questions: What was the total number of books lent in those two months?
The librarian's goal was 90 loans. By how many loans did the library miss the goal?

problem: Aiko had 6 postcards pinned to her bedroom wall. Her pen pal mailed her 6 more. How many postcards does she have now?
follow_up_questions: Her wall board has space for 20 postcards. How many more can she pin up?

problem: How many cars are in the car park? Early in the morning 6 cars parked there, and by lunchtime 6 more had arrived.
follow_up_questions: The car park has 20 spaces. How many spaces are still free?

problem: Mateo earned 25 dollars walking dogs in March, 18 dollars in April and 22 dollars in May. Then he spent 30 dollars on new trainers. How much money does he have left?
How much money is left in the class trip jar? The class collected 25 dollars at the bake sale, 18 at the car wash and 22 at the book swap, then paid 30 dollars for the bus.
On the zoo tour, 8 children joined the morning group and 7 joined the afternoon group. How many children took the tour that day?
follow_up_questions: Each child receives 2 animal stickers. How many stickers are handed out?

problem: How many swimmers had lessons at the pool today? There were 8 in the early class and 7 in the late class.
follow_up_questions: Each swimmer used 2 floats. How many floats were used?

problem: At the school clean-up, Ingrid filled 37 bags of leaves and Tomas filled 18. Their teacher swept 30 metres of path. How many bags of leaves did Ingrid and Tomas fill?
How many jars of jam did the two sisters label? Anouk labelled 37 jars and Pia labelled 18, while their mother washed 30 spoons.
A tour boat travels 9 kilometres every hour. How far does it go in 4 hours?
follow_up_questions: Its fuel tank holds enough for 40 kilometres. How many kilometres' worth of fuel is left after the trip?

problem: How far does Sima's pony trot if it keeps going for 4 hours at 9 kilometres an hour?
follow_up_questions: Sima's map shows the camp is 40 kilometres from the start. How many kilometres are still left to go?

problem: The bakery sold 13 birthday cakes on Monday and 18 on Tuesday. The baker expects to sell 16 on Wednesday. The shop always smells of cinnamon. How many birthday cakes is that altogether?
follow_up_questions: The baker bought enough boxes for 60 cakes over the three days. How many boxes will be left over?

problem: Altogether, how many visitors will the museum have had? It welcomed 13 visitors on Friday and 18 on Saturday, and the guide expects 16 on Sunday. A huge dinosaur skeleton stands in the hall.
follow_up_questions: The museum printed 60 maps for those three days. How many maps will not be used?

problem: There are 8 green crayons in the box. Luis finds 5 more under the table and puts them in. How many green crayons are in the box now?
follow_up_questions: He gives 6 of them to his classmates. How many green crayons are left in the box?
His sister adds twice as many yellow crayons as there are green ones left. How many yellow crayons does she add?

problem: How many shells are in Ama's bucket after she adds the 5 she found by the rocks? The bucket already held 8.
follow_up_questions: She uses 6 shells to decorate a sandcastle. How many shells remain in the bucket?
Her friend drops in twice as many pebbles as there are shells left. How many pebbles does her friend add?

problem: Sana empties her piggy bank and finds only dimes, worth 70 cents in all. How many dimes are there?
follow_up_questions: Her grandpa gives her 4 more dimes. How many dimes does she have now?

problem: How many dimes did the lemonade stand take in? Every customer paid with a single dime, and the money box now holds 70 cents.
follow_up_questions: Then 4 more customers each pay a dime. How many dimes are in the box now?

problem: A rowing boat drifts 18 kilometres down the river at 6 kilometres an hour. How many hours does the trip take?
How long will it take Grandma Elsa to walk the whole forest trail, which is 18 kilometres long, if she walks 6 kilometres each hour?
The school has 5 buses, but only 3 bus drivers came to work today. How many more buses than drivers are there?
follow_up_questions: Later 4 more drivers show up. Now how many more drivers than buses are there?

problem: How many more horses than riders are at the stable this morning? There are 5 horses saddled up and just 3 riders waiting.
follow_up_questions: Then 4 more riders arrive. Now how many more riders than horses are there?

problem: Felix owned 9 toy boats and 5 toy planes. He gave 2 of the boats to his friend. How many toy boats does Felix have left?
